name: 54409 · Antigo, WI
findings: ZIP 54409 (Antigo) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54409 (Antigo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
